# peaApp dashboard

`PARTIAL_STATIC` — first static analysis of worldbank/peaApp main at [520eace](../assistant_rules/0001.md#L128-L158), analysed 2026-10-15. No app, R or tests were run and no input observations were inspected.

`VERIFIED_STATIC` The traced production entrypoint consumes compiled local indicator data and saved figures, then filters and presents plots, tables and metadata. It reads Parquet and RDS files under data-app/; a separate build pipeline assembles external aggregate sources. `app.R:L3-L23`; `data-raw/20-pea-db-data-compillation.R:L326-L443`. This route does not reproduce a survey-level PEA focus-country calculation.

Start with [plain-language answers](0001.md#L6-L21), the [display index](0002.md#L306-L346), [label mismatches](0004.md#L331-L348), [ingestion/refresh](0002.md#L129-L146) and [year selection](0002.md#L6-L36).

`VERIFIED_STATIC` Extracted **588 active cell/series templates**: 148 figure-field bindings across 48 figures, plus 440 table-cell templates across three active tables, using 131 distinct field names. Counts describe configuration, not populated outputs. Three additional workbook tables are documented as inactive. The first-sheet catalogs retain 252 variable-label rows and 131 subgroup-label rows. See [verification](0010.md#L576-L615).

`VERIFIED_STATIC` / `INFERRED` The [mismatch register](0004.md#L331-L348) has 16 families, separating 12 direct configuration/code contradictions from 4 conditional findings. These include Table 1's 15+ label, employment denominator wording, vulnerability-band descriptions, and GDP/PPP labels. Overridden and inactive labels are explicitly marked. Actual deployed values and upstream file identities remain `UNVERIFIED`.

# Why the dashboard can disagree with another product

`PARTIAL_STATIC`. These mechanisms identify checks to make; none establishes the cause of a particular published difference.

| Mechanism | Established dashboard behavior | Comparison boundary |
|---|---|---|
| Different data vintage | Startup uses local compiled artifacts and saved figures; the Update button does not fetch sources. `app.R:L12-L23`; `R/m-filter.R:L157-L180`. | `INFERRED` A separately updated Stata cache can differ. Deployed vintages remain `UNVERIFIED`. |
| Focus-country calculation | The traced dashboard route consumes aggregate indicators, including GMI labour; it does not calculate survey-level labour fields. `data-raw/10-gmi-extended.qmd:L689-L787`; `app.R:L12-L23`. | `INFERRED` PEA C.1's local focus column can use different supplied survey fields/denominators. See [its record](../stata_commands/0004.md#L389-L413). |
| Recall coalescing | No survey-level weekly/annual labour coalescing appears in this aggregate import. `data-raw/10-gmi-extended.qmd:L689-L787`. | `INFERRED` If its external file uses the documented [GMI construction](../gmi_lineage/0005.md#L1140-L1157), upstream coalescing is inherited. Neither the file's build commit nor a a given country dashboard value is established. |
| Different quantities under one label | Active/inactive label mismatches are recorded separately. | `VERIFIED_STATIC` [16 families](0004.md#L331-L348), with explicitly weaker tags for conditional cases. |
| Scale and presentation | Build multipliers, R-derived GICs, decimal formatting, per-card scale settings and label replacements all exist. `data-raw/20-pea-db-data-compillation.R:L113-L123`; `data-raw/10-gmi-extended.qmd:L327-L332`; `R/ft-helpers.R:L99-L106`. | `INFERRED` Compare stored units and display units before treating a ratio of 100 as a statistical disagreement. |
| Year selection / climate reference | Multiple selection paths and replicated climate display years exist. | `VERIFIED_STATIC` [Year rules](0002.md#L6-L36). Equality with a Stata invocation is `UNVERIFIED`. |
| Peer averages | Dashboard Table 1 averages retained peer values arithmetically. `R/f-tbl.R:L177-L196`. | `INFERRED` PEA C.1's [population-weighted group/benchmark aggregates](../stata_commands/0004.md#L389-L413) need not match. Ordinary country columns are a separate comparison. |
| Vulnerability | National povvul comes from PIP differences; demographic vulnerability is computed from GMI group counts/rates. `data-raw/10-gmi-extended.qmd:L512-L548`; `data-raw/10-gmi-extended.qmd:L924-L1019`. | `INFERRED` Neither “GMI precomputed” nor “PEA output” alone describes these R-derived values. Compare the exact thresholds, subgroup basis and [PPP issue](0001.md#L557-L602). |
| MPM | Loads WLD_GMI_MPM.dta components and mdpoor_i1, then applies metadata scale; it does not run PEA's local MPM construction. `data-raw/11-pip.qmd:L146-L175`; `data-raw/20-pea-db-data-compillation.R:L113-L123`. | `INFERRED` The [PEA local MPM path](../stata_commands/0040.md#L513-L539) can differ in dimension availability/eligibility. Shared field names do not prove identical production. |
| Metadata or duplicate loss | Field labels are built separately; labour import keeps first rows at a restricted key. `data-raw/02-mapping-tables.R:L9-L77`; `data-raw/10-gmi-extended.qmd:L733-L751`. | `INFERRED` Different source versions or duplicate records can change what survives; data contents were not checked. |

# Which year is shown?

`VERIFIED_STATIC` There is no single “latest available” rule. The main selector uses available fgt0 years, and individual cards decide which year flags to keep. `R/m-filter.R:L673-L676`; `R/m-filter.R:L725-L752`; `R/f-flter-global.R:L10-L50`.

| Context | Rule at this pin | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Default inputs | Years 2023, 2021, 2018, in that order; PPP 2021. These are defaults, not claimed survey availability. | `VERIFIED_STATIC` `R/f-flter-global.R:L86-L108` |
| Main closest-year flags | For each country/PPP in packaged availability_dta$year, retain nearest year within inclusive ±3; break ties with later year. First requested year receives flag 1. Other requested years receive flag 2 after excluding first-target matches; duplicates are then removed per country/year. | `VERIFIED_STATIC` `R/f-flter-global.R:L301-L387` |
| What defines availability | Availability years are built from var=fgt0, not availability of each labour/MPM/ASPIRE variable. Main flags reference packaged availability_dta by default; UI receives con$dta_avail from the RDS. | `VERIFIED_STATIC` `R/m-filter.R:L725-L752`; `R/f-flter-global.R:L302-L310`; `R/f-flter-global.R:L342-L360`; `R/m-filter.R:L92-L97` |
| Time-series figures | Cards without year_fltr keep the surviving time series; flag assignment is not itself a universal year filter. | `VERIFIED_STATIC` `data-app/meta-fig-v2.yml:L229-L270`; `R/f-flter-global.R:L372-L387`; `R/f-fltrplt.R:L12-L26` |
| Key tables | Keep flags 1/2. Focus years are sorted descending. Peer helper picks the closest remaining peer year to the greatest focus year; ties favor later years. Its own ±year_range guard is commented out, so it adds no independent three-year bound to the already filtered candidates. | `VERIFIED_STATIC` `data-app/meta-fig-v2.yml:L147-L228`; `R/f-tbl.R:L148-L175`; `R/f-reshapers.R:L46-L64` |
| Scatter build | For selected variables, build circa observations per country/variable at nearest year within ±3, choosing later ties. | `VERIFIED_STATIC` `data-raw/20-pea-db-data-compillation.R:L240-L285` |
| Scatter display | Derive focus years from surviving flags; keep matching year_circa values; take first row per variable/country/country-colour/year_circa. x and y retain separate source years. | `VERIFIED_STATIC` `R/f-fltrplt.R:L312-L408` |
| ASPIRE views | Choose max(year) within country after selected-field filtering, not each indicator’s own latest nonmissing year. | `VERIFIED_STATIC` `R/f-fltrplt.R:L431-L439`; `data-app/meta-fig-v2.yml:L1898-L2058` |
| Climate 2021-PPP input | Take max source year per country, save it as ref_year, replicate records over display years 2000–2027. Climate figures select year=2021 but tooltip uses ref_year. | `VERIFIED_STATIC` `data-raw/15-climrisk.qmd:L76-L87`; `data-raw/15-climrisk.qmd:L131-L155`; `data-app/meta-fig-v2.yml:L1809-L1897` |
| Table climate row | After country/year selection, retain risk_any on 2021 if any 2021 row exists for that country, otherwise on max remaining year; this inspects display year, not ref_year. | `VERIFIED_STATIC` `R/f-tbl.R:L232-L234`; `R/f-tbl.R:L378-L390` |
| Spells | All, Selected and Latest spell copies; Latest takes greatest year_to then smallest year_from within country. | `VERIFIED_STATIC` `R/f-flter-global.R:L478-L519` |

`INFERRED` A labour value can be absent even where that labour field has a different recent year: the global flag is based on poverty-year availability. Bundled availability and the startup RDS can also become inconsistent if rebuilt separately. These possibilities were not tested.

`VERIFIED_STATIC` Several scatter tooltip templates print the x-variable year alongside the y-variable value, even though the scatter helper retains y_year separately. The MPM peer note hard-codes “within 3 years to 2021” while its filter selects year_fltr=1. Both are display-text caveats, not evidence that all data use 2021. `data-app/meta-fig-v2.yml:L310-L317`; `data-app/meta-fig-v2.yml:L412-L451`; `R/f-fltrplt.R:L358-L388`.

# GMI Extended repository intelligence

Source: `dasalm20/gmi_extended`. The pipeline that builds global comparator indicators consumed by both the PEA Stata package and the peaApp dashboard.

This folder in `PEA_ai_help_center` holds the GMI Extended AI documentation. Production source directories remain in the upstream repository and are pulled into a local checkout when documentation is refreshed. [PROVENANCE.md](../assistant_rules/0001.md#L253-L291) distinguishes the analysed source commit from the documentation snapshot copied here.

Start with [operating rules](0002.md#L56-L74), [coverage](../../../lookup/sources/GMI_extended/coverage.json.md), and the [reference-period audit](0005.md#L1140-L1157). This is a persistent static knowledge base, not a successful pipeline run or a claim of complete runtime lineage.

The analyzed snapshot has 25 Stata files: nine current pipeline files, nine archived workflows, and seven QA/reharmonization files. Every lexically active statement has a block record, exact source text, enclosing controls, and next-block navigation. Read [coverage](../../../lookup/sources/GMI_extended/coverage.json.md) for the distinction between statement indexing and full semantic analysis. No input datasets or user-written command implementations are bundled.

The key result is **conditional mixing of labor recall definitions**. `industycat4` and `industycat4_year` are absent; actual fields are `industrycat4` and `industrycat4_year`. Current 01aa/01ab fill missing primary values from annual values. Current 01b applies this fill only to the later ALL endpoint. See the audit for exact source citations and an indicator comparison table.

GMI_extended/analysis/reference_period_a.context:
# Are GMI Extended indicators reference-period agnostic?

**No blanket claim is supported.** Current industry and several labor indicators can mix primary and annual recall fields. Some welfare-only paths do not use the labor recall fields at all, while spell outputs separately depend on their selected endpoint years. Classifications below concern the labor recall dimension; they do not imply independence from survey year, PPP vintage, welfare recall, reporting year, or spell choice.

This report describes the analyzed commit in `manifest.json`. A concurrent source update added an asymmetric fallback to 01b during this analysis; the archived spell file still uses primary industry at both endpoints. Evidence: `01.Programs/01b-GMI extended indicators spells.do:L496-L584`; `01.Programs/archive/01b-GMI extended indicators spells.do:L406-L485`.

# PEA command templates

These are starting points using the package example's variable names. Substitute your own variables, country, peers, years and filenames. Choose one entry and load a fresh copy of your survey; these are separate examples, not one do-file.

Source: `worldbank/pea`, branch `Package_updates-SEP-30th`, commit `4ec2b06ce63e99771630a8f1e1bb8447cbd6f744`. `VERIFIED_STATIC` The calls were checked against the declarations at this revision. `UNVERIFIED` No Stata execution or successful country-year output is established. Known limitations appear beside the relevant calls.

- `EXTERNAL_DEPENDENCY` Use Stata 18 with PEA, its dependencies and the saved data listed in [setup](../stata_commands/0015.md#L223-L240) and each full record.
- `VERIFIED_STATIC` The PPP conversion shown assumes annual `welfare` and matching `cpi2021`/`icp2021`. Keep any correctly prepared variables already present and skip their `gen` lines. Supply your country's actual `natwelfare` and `natline`; the presence checks do not establish correct values. `source-ref-18e45afd459d1b95184f.do:L15-L36`.
- `VERIFIED_STATIC` `head`, `married` and `nowork` use raw GMD codes. `nowork` is 0 working, 1 not working, missing when unknown. [Input contracts](../stata_commands/0004.md#L520-L568) explain the preparation.
- `EXTERNAL_DEPENDENCY` Supply actual survey-comparability groups in `comparability` and observations for both years in each spell. Multiple pairs use a semicolon: `spells(0000 0000; 0000 0000)`. `Stata/plus/p/pea_figure3a.ado:L51-L719`; `source-ref-18e45afd459d1b95184f.do:L148-L148`.
- `VERIFIED_STATIC` `excel()` needs an existing workbook, so each block creates one in the current directory. Choose an unused filename and keep it identical in the preparation and call; `confirm new file` stops if it exists. `Stata/plus/_/_pea_export_path.ado:L20-L35`; `Stata/plus/p/pea_core.ado:L93-L99`.

# Bundled groupfunction dependency

Source: `worldbank/pea@4ec2b06ce63e99771630a8f1e1bb8447cbd6f744`, `Stata/plus/g/groupfunction.ado` (795 lines) and companion help (173 lines). `ADDED` to this source tree; banner says version 2.2, 28 Jan 2021. This does not establish which version a user's adopath loads.

`VERIFIED_STATIC` Accepted [if] [in] [aw pw fw]; options sum, rawsum, mean, first, max, min, count, sd, gini, theil, variance, by, norestore, xtile, nq, missing, slow, merge. `Stata/plus/g/groupfunction.ado:L16-L41`. Means use supplied weights, rawsum uses unit weights, count counts nonmissing observations, sd/variance use Mata quadvariance. `missing` affects all-missing sum/rawsum groups; `merge` adds named results to current data instead of replacing it with aggregates. `Stata/plus/g/groupfunction.ado:L207-L279`; `Stata/plus/g/groupfunction.ado:L331-L422`; `Stata/plus/g/groupfunction.ado:L446-L601`.

`VERIFIED_STATIC` Gini/Theil route through CpBCaLC. Gini first tries Python; on failure uses Mata's sorted weighted cumulative sum formula. Theil is weighted mean of `(y/weighted_mean(y))*ln(y/weighted_mean(y))`. `Stata/plus/g/groupfunction.ado:L281-L303`; `Stata/plus/g/groupfunction.ado:L637-L735`; `Stata/plus/g/groupfunction.ado:L766-L795`.

`EXTERNAL_DEPENDENCY` Python integration, NumPy and Stata/Mata execution were not tested. The bundled help's example 2 uses inconsistent names regions/region and weight/w; it is historical upstream text, not a validated runnable template.

`VERIFIED_STATIC` Callers include Table 1/C.1/10 Gini and means; Table 2/3/4/5/7/A2 and Figures 1/2/6/7/8/10 aggregates; Table 14 shares; pea_dataupdate regional/income-group population-weighted aggregates. `Stata/plus/p/pea_tableC1.ado:L187-L187`; `Stata/plus/p/pea_table1.ado:L148-L148`; `Stata/plus/p/pea_dataupdate.ado:L609-L619`. Existing calls were not edited by this update except source/comment movement. `INFERRED` Gini/Theil if/in forwarding differs from mean/count; see U05 in [current status](../stata_errors/0005.md#L390-L424).

`UNVERIFIED` Setup checks file presence with findfile, without verifying version or installation path. No package installation manifest was added in this diff. The added dependency does not prove deployment. `Stata/plus/p/pea_setup.ado:L44-L59`.

`VERIFIED_STATIC` Accepted [if] [in] [aw pw fw]; options sum, rawsum, mean, first, max, min, count, sd, gini, theil, variance, by, norestore, xtile, nq, missing, slow, merge. `Stata/plus/g/groupfunction.ado:L16-L41`. Means use supplied weights, rawsum uses unit weights, count counts nonmissing observations, sd/variance use Mata quadvariance. `missing` affects all-missing sum/rawsum groups; `merge` adds named results to current data instead of replacing it with aggregates. `Stata/plus/g/groupfunction.ado:L207-L279`; `Stata/plus/g/groupfunction.ado:L331-L422`; `Stata/plus/g/groupfunction.ado:L446-L601`.

`VERIFIED_STATIC` Gini/Theil route through CpBCaLC. Gini first tries Python; on failure uses Mata's sorted weighted cumulative sum formula. Theil is weighted mean of `(y/weighted_mean(y))*ln(y/weighted_mean(y))`. `Stata/plus/g/groupfunction.ado:L281-L303`; `Stata/plus/g/groupfunction.ado:L637-L735`; `Stata/plus/g/groupfunction.ado:L766-L795`.

`EXTERNAL_DEPENDENCY` Python integration, NumPy and Stata/Mata execution were not tested. The bundled help's example 2 uses inconsistent names regions/region and weight/w; it is historical upstream text, not a validated runnable template.

`VERIFIED_STATIC` Callers include Table 1/C.1/10 Gini and means; Table 2/3/4/5/7/A2 and Figures 1/2/6/7/8/10 aggregates; Table 14 shares; pea_dataupdate regional/income-group population-weighted aggregates. `Stata/plus/p/pea_tableC1.ado:L187-L187`; `Stata/plus/p/pea_table1.ado:L148-L148`; `Stata/plus/p/pea_dataupdate.ado:L609-L619`. Existing calls were not edited by this update except source/comment movement. `INFERRED` Gini/Theil if/in forwarding differs from mean/count; see U05 in [current status](../stata_errors/0005.md#L390-L424).

`UNVERIFIED` Setup checks file presence with findfile, without verifying version or installation path. No package installation manifest was added in this diff. The added dependency does not prove deployment. `Stata/plus/p/pea_setup.ado:L44-L59`.
